# Shipp-Mates Epoxy of the Ozarks

> Locally owned epoxy and polyaspartic concrete floor coating contractor based in Osage Beach, Missouri, serving the Lake of the Ozarks region within roughly a 75-mile radius. Residential garages, basements, patios, man caves and shops, plus commercial, church and school floors, decorative acid staining, and concrete repair.

Contact: 417.255.6890 · shippmatesepoxy@gmail.com · Osage Beach, MO
Website: https://shippmatesepoxy.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShippmatesEpoxy
Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/rQW1NgK3evyzxRiU7

## What the company does

- Full flake polyaspartic/polyurea floor coating systems
- Metallic epoxy floors
- Acid stained (acid reactive) decorative concrete
- Patio, pool deck and other exterior concrete coatings
- Commercial, institutional and auto shop floors
- Concrete crack repair, joint filling, leveling and sealing

Every install includes full diamond grinding surface prep, and most residential
projects are completed in one day. Work is backed by a written warranty.

## Services

- [Epoxy Garage Floors](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/garage-floors.html): Full flake, solid color and metallic polyaspartic garage systems. UV stable and hot-tire resistant.
- [Basement Floor Coatings](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/basement-floors.html): Moisture-resistant coatings for basements, home gyms and finished lower levels.
- [Metallic Epoxy Floors](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/metallic-epoxy.html): Liquid-metal decorative epoxy for luxury garages, showrooms and high-end interiors.
- [Acid Stained Concrete](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/acid-staining.html): Acid reactive stain that etches translucent, marbled color into the slab itself, then is sealed. Color varies with each slab and cannot be matched exactly to a photo.
- [Patio & Outdoor Coatings](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/patio-coatings.html): UV- and slip-resistant systems for patios, pool decks, porches and driveways.
- [ManCaves & Shop Floors](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/mancave-shop.html): Custom color floors for man caves, she sheds, home gyms and shop buildings.
- [Commercial Floor Coatings](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/commercial.html): Industrial-grade systems for warehouses, retail, restaurants and auto shops.
- [Churches & Schools](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/churches-schools.html): Durable, slip-resistant, easy-clean floors for institutional buildings.
- [Concrete Repair & Sealing](https://shippmatesepoxy.com/concrete-repair.html): Crack repair, joint filling, surface leveling and sealing.

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing shown on the site is an estimate range. Final pricing requires an on-site quote.
- Acid stain results vary by slab; sample boards are provided but exact color matching is not guaranteed.
- The company is a newer business and does not publish customer review counts or star ratings.
